"""Main: bounded CPU fixtures and actual read-only user-service preflight."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
P = B / 'latest-update-integrated-neutral-controller-source-v6'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('controller_cpu_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
           XDG_RUNTIME_DIR='/run/user/1000', DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS='unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus')
with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'latest-update-main-controller-cpu-root-v13'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    pins = {p.name: m.sha(p) for p in sorted(P.glob('*.py'))}
    assert len(pins) == 7
    r = dict(passed=False, complete=False, active=True, commands=[], main_reviewed=True,
             gpu_executed=False, model_launch_attempted=False, controller_source_pins=pins,
             controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), whole_wall_seconds=120)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    def run(label, argv):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, P, wall=45, cpu=60, rss_cap=4 << 30,
                              text_cap=16 << 20, file_cap=16 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label)
        return so.read_text()
    try:
        text = run('parser-owned-mock-pending', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B',
                    str(P / 'controller_cpu_fixtures.py'), '--owned-mock-output',
                    str(out / 'mock'), '--owned-stop-output', str(out / 'stop-mock'), '--invalid-pending-output', str(out / 'invalid-pending')])
        result = json.loads(text)
        r['fixture_result'] = result
        keys = ('parser_malformed_fixtures_passed', 'owned_mock_quit_passed',
                'invalid_admission_prelaunch_passed', 'invalid_pending_process_passed', 'budget_stop_mock_quit_passed')
        assert all(result.get(k) is True for k in keys)
        r.update({k: result[k] for k in keys})
        for key in ('commands', 'invalid_pending_commands', 'budget_stop_mock_commands'):
            assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in result[key])
        text = run('inactive-embedding-read-only', ['/usr/bin/systemctl', '--user', 'show',
                   'llama-server-qwen3embed.service', '-p', 'ActiveState'])
        assert text.strip() == 'ActiveState=inactive'
        assert all(m.sha(P / p) == digest for p, digest in pins.items())
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'fixture_result']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
